name: Site & Zoning
scope: Indonesian RDTR/zoning analysis and general site investigation procedures.

coverage.limitations: Indexed national spatial portals (GISTARU, Tanah Air Indonesia), JDIH databases and selected hazard, climate and statistics sources support navigation for existing procedures; the controlling kabupaten/kota RDTR or RTRW text and KRK must be retrieved for current applicable provisions. General site research requires location-specific sources. Source reachability checks use available authorized host facilities and do not establish legal applicability. Retained source-health tools are maintainer/historical inventory; no cluster-wide workflow validation is claimed.

host_requirements: skill-specific tools and authorized workspace access when required
Available authorized source-retrieval capability for requested reachability checks; no Arch Studio runner requirement

evaluations.claim: Manifest membership and portability only; not workflow acceptance
Shared source dependencies and truthful cluster declarations only; not workflow validation
